_schema.description: GATE G2 — THE OWNER FILLS THIS IN. Read clusters.json, then record which Etsy listing survives each cluster as a product on the new site. Every Shopify handle in a dropped or kept cluster 301s to the survivor. Nothing builds the site catalog until this file is filled. Do not generate it automatically.

row.keep: etsyListingId, or null to drop the whole design
row.redirectTo: etsyListingId whose new URL the cluster's Shopify handles 301 to — usually same as keep; null sends them to a collection
